note: vid-segment Tier A eval. vid-segment writes ONE body segment per run, so each case names the slug, the corpus seed, the target segment heading, and the expected save-side effects. Input state per case: the frozen after-intake brain-dump.md from input_stage (source text), plus a suite-local after-structure state under fixtures/{slug}/ (piece.md with status: drafting + segment_purposes + segments_completed + tension_plan + *_used arrays, and script.md the vid-structure skeleton with prior segments already written). The suite-local fixtures exist because fixtures/stages/after-structure does not exist yet; when that stage is frozen for real, point suite_fixtures at it instead. Output contract per case (written by the test runner to outputs/case_NN/): script.md (the skeleton with the segment prose appended under its heading, all other sections preserved), piece.md (frontmatter updated: segments_completed appended, the matching *_used arrays appended, last_updated bumped, every other field untouched), banks/{bank-dir}/{slug}.md for EVERY bank entry pulled this run (status flipped captured to used, used_in gains [[{piece-slug}]]), and transcript.md (the creator gate conversation; never scored for fabrication or brand rules because it legitimately echoes the creator's words). Per-case spec fields: segment_heading (substring of the target ## heading), segment_label (the label appended to segments_completed), min_words (deterministic floor for filming-ready prose; lower for the adversarial case because a segment with an honestly-missing proof is legitimately lean), expected_used (exact set of wikilinks each *_used array must GAIN; anything more or less fails, which is what makes the adversarial case gate on zero additions), bank_updates (bank entries the run must write back flipped), parable_anchors (tokens from the picked parable material that must appear in the prose), handoff_cues (any one must appear in the segment's final paragraph, the forward-hook floor), requires_callout (a callout type like todo that must appear inside the segment section), allowed_drops (fixture lines the run may legitimately delete, e.g. a To build row this segment consumed).
